+  describe "alias declarations (transparent synonyms)" do
+    test "an alias is substituted out of every type position (transitively)" do
+      %{funcs: [f]} =
+        Decl.parse("""
+        alias Id := Int64
+        alias Count := Id
+
+        def add(x Id, y Count) Id := x + y
+        """)
+
+      assert f.params == [

+    end
+

+  end
